reuse.why: It hooks into the existing ensureAccountNotLinked guard that every provider link function already calls, but copies unlinkAccount's local-clear update instead of extracting it into something both share.

duplication.why: The eight-field db.updateAccount block that clears an account's link state is copied verbatim from unlinkAccount in app.ts into link.ts.

placement.why: The takeover lives in link.ts beside the other link rules, but a function named ensureAccountNotLinked now mutates another account, so a check-style guard hides a side effect.

scope.why: Only the flag plumbing through the six provider link functions, the guard and one test change.

maintainability.why: If the definition of 'unlinked' changes, both unlinkAccount and the copy in ensureAccountNotLinked must change, and the misleading guard name makes the takeover easy to miss.

bypasses_abstraction.where: link.ts ensureAccountNotLinked re-writes the local unlink update from app.ts unlinkAccount instead of sharing a local-unlink helper with it

disguised_duplication.where: The copied updateAccount block is a verbatim copy, not a reshaped one.
